definitions.gloss: imprisonment without labor (as a criminal sentence)
definitions.explanation: A form of imprisonment under Japanese criminal law in which the convict is confined to a prison but, unlike {懲役刑|ちょうえきけい}, is not required to perform compulsory labor. Historically given for crimes considered to involve no moral turpitude, such as some negligence offenses. Under criminal-law reforms that took effect in June 2025, {禁固刑|きんこけい} was unified with {懲役刑|ちょうえきけい} into a single sentence called {拘禁刑|こうきんけい}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被告|ひこく}→被告：11080_hikoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{禁固刑|きんこけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: The defendant received a sentence of imprisonment without labor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裁判所|さいばんしょ}→裁判所：09665_saibansho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{禁固刑|きんこけい}3⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}い{渡|わた}した→言い渡す：07002_iiwatasu⟧。
examples.english: The court handed down three years' imprisonment without labor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{過失|かしつ}→過失：00194_kashitsu⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦{致死|ちし}→致死：10002_chishi⟧{罪|ざい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{禁固刑|きんこけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{科|か}される→科す：30906_kasu⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In cases of negligent driving causing death, imprisonment without labor may also be imposed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改正|かいせい}→改正：00446_kaisei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、{懲役刑|ちょうえきけい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{禁固刑|きんこけい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{拘禁刑|こうきんけい}→拘禁刑：31846_koukinkei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一本化|いっぽんか}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Through a change in the law, imprisonment with labor and imprisonment without labor were unified into a single confinement sentence.

notes:
Composed of {禁固|きんこ} (confinement, being locked up) and -⟦{刑|けい}→刑：02786_kei⟧ (punishment, sentence). Sometimes also written {禁錮刑|きんこけい} with the original statutory kanji {錮|こ}, which is not on the jōyō list; {禁固|きんこ} is the substitute spelling used in newspapers and general writing. Refers specifically to the criminal-law sentence, not to detention in general.

USAGE:
A technical legal term; appears in court news, legal textbooks, and novels involving crime or trials. In everyday speech, people often say ⟦{刑務所|けいむしょ}→刑務所：19074_keimusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (to go to prison) without distinguishing the type of sentence. Journalists frequently use {禁固|きんこ} (without -⟦{刑|けい}→刑：02786_kei⟧) as a modifier, for example {禁固|きんこ}3⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ (three years' imprisonment without labor).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {禁固刑|きんこけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{科|か}す→科す：30906_kasu⟧: to impose a sentence of imprisonment without labor
- {禁固刑|きんこけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive a sentence of imprisonment without labor
- {禁固|きんこ}3⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧: a verdict of three years' imprisonment without labor
- ⟦{執行|しっこう}{猶予|ゆうよ}→執行猶予：18434_shikkouyuuyo⟧⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{禁固刑|きんこけい}: imprisonment without labor with suspended execution
- {禁固刑|きんこけい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{処|しょ}される→処する：30647_shosuru⟧: to be sentenced to imprisonment without labor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {懲役刑|ちょうえきけい}: imprisonment with labor — inmates are required to perform prison labor
- ⟦{拘禁刑|こうきんけい}→拘禁刑：31846_koukinkei⟧: confinement sentence — the unified sentence that replaced both {懲役刑|ちょうえきけい} and {禁固刑|きんこけい} in June 2025
- {罰金刑|ばっきんけい}: fine (as a sentence) — a monetary penalty imposed by the court
- ⟦{拘留|こうりゅう}→拘留：21416_kouryuu⟧: short-term detention — a minor confinement sentence of at least 1 day and less than 30 days
- ⟦{執行|しっこう}{猶予|ゆうよ}→執行猶予：18434_shikkouyuuyo⟧: suspended sentence — the sentence is not carried out immediately, pending good behavior
